name: loop-in-mcp
description: Async human-in-the-loop input via shareable links — Claude asks people outside your coding session for input, you keep working.

loop_base_url.title: Loop backend URL
loop_base_url.description: Loop backend base URL. Default is the hosted instance; override for self-hosted or local dev.

loop_token.title: Loop API token
loop_token.description: Leave blank if you don't have one yet — run /loop-in-connect after install. Otherwise paste your Loop API token (starts with lp_).
